entities.name: Fountain of Cho
entities.description: A site of reverence for the Cho-Arrim, the Navel of the World, believed to have curative waters.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Brought Orim to the fountain and shared its significance.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Fascinated by the runes; shared a first kiss with Cho-Manno.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: Forest whose trees are larger than the fountain's saplings.

events.summary: In 4205 AR Cho-Manno brought Orim to the fountain; they shared their first kiss.
events.quote: They shared their first kiss next to its gushing waters.

relations.quote: They shared their first kiss next to its gushing waters.
